title: Effects of Supplementary Oxygen on Dyspnoea and Exercise Tolerance in COPD Patients Given LTOT
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to evaluate effects of supplementary oxygen during exercise on dyspnoea and exercise tolerance in COPD-patients given long-time oxygen treatment
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* COPD patients (male/female)given long-term oxygen treatment
* Able to perform two separate walking tests

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe heart failure
